title: HOPE build-info
description: Immutable build identity baked into every HOPE image at /app/build-info.json. Written by the Dockerfile from CI build args (TASK-648 §3.2); read once at process boot. This is NOT configuration — it is a property of the artifact, so it must never be settable from a Deployment manifest, an env file, or turbo.json#globalEnv. The image digest is deliberately absent: it does not exist until after the push, and is attached to the release row by CI instead.

service.description: Image/process name as built by CI (SERVICE_NAME in .gitlab/ci/build.yml).

version.description: SemVer from the release tag, or 0.0.0-<branch-slug>.<sha8> for an untagged build. Produced by parseReleaseTag / formatUntaggedVersion in @arcaai/utils — never hand-formatted, never read from package.json.

releaseTag.description: The git tag that produced this build, e.g. SMR-2.1.0. Null on untagged builds.

gitBranch.description: Branch the build ran on. Empty string when the pipeline ran on a detached tag with no branch context.

gitCommitSha.description: Full 40-character commit SHA. The short form is derived at display time, never stored separately.

buildAt.description: UTC RFC3339 instant the image was built, matching org.opencontainers.image.created.
